author: Jesus_Gar2a
body:
I was banned in the scrimm cause of anti-knockback, I need to be unbanned cause I wasn't using anything during the scrim apart of Optifine, the ban is wrong cause I repeat I wasn't using anything in the scrimm, I have some videos of me playing in the avicus network and the log report from the day of the scrim, I am banned since June 15 of 2015, I have been banned of ban evading but it as been proved that It wasn't me the one that used the first account cause it was a public account, I have appealed already with this one 3 times.
I have been like for 1 year and more than 5 months in avicus With 62,000 kills , I dont see why to hack now and more important during a tournament, I think that I am quite known in the network, and if I where hacking during all that time I think that I would have been already banned, in the video of Sho before 3:35 you can see I never disconnected and you can see I take knockack before that part of the video

Now here is the log report via mediafire https://www.mediafire.com/?1q92dh5f7dqa1nb
and here are some videos of me playing just with optifine
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F9zQUO60HL4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y76dLwBnqyE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z4i63VprFvI

title: Jesus_Gar2a Anti-knockback Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

After a discussion with the Officials, and after reviewing all the evidence, we have decided that you will remain banned. The reason for this is that we have solid evidence of you not taking any Knockback. In addition, logs aren't valid evidence as it can be modified very easily.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
